pages.title: Ringed Seal
pages.text: The ringed seal ($(o)Pusa hispida$()) is the smallest and most common seal of the Arctic, named for the pale rings on its dark back.$(br2)It keeps breathing holes open in thick sea ice with its claws, and raises its white-coated pup in a snow den on the ice.$(br2)It is the main prey of the polar bear.
